ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Significant high-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal margins of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a large, contiguous mottled area extending from the tip toward the midline. The right lobe features a more discrete white patch at the tip containing a horizontal dark pixel streak. Several isolated white focal spots (1-3 pixel radius) are scattered across the dark central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an approximate internal angle of 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitudes of variations are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, featuring sharp peaks and shallow valleys relative to the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the notch toward the distal tips, which terminate in an upward-oriented convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters, notably one prominent white rosette on the lower-right dark region and several smaller clusters scattered across the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a distinct, thin, unaligned white linear mark approximately 100 pixels in length, oriented diagonally on the lower-right lobe toward the notch.

ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible diagonal linear scratch on the right lobe; a unique dark horizontal 'eye-shaped' marking within the right distal white patch; multiple small circular puncture-like scars across the central dark pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.other_distinctive_markers: The right distal high-intensity region contains a highly unique horizontal dark streak motif that breaks the white pigmentation.
